title: All grown-ups were once children, but only few of them remember it
summary: This is a philosophical reflection by renowned mathematician Terence Tao, referencing Saint-Exupéry's 'The Little Prince', about the importance of maintaining childlike curiosity and wonder in mathematical thinking and research even as one becomes an established adult mathematician.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of preserving creative, fresh perspectives and genuine curiosity in mathematical work as researchers mature in their careers.
why_valuable: Offers profound insight into the psychological and philosophical aspects of mathematical creativity, encouraging mathematicians to maintain the open-mindedness and wonder characteristic of childhood inquiry.
